records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Pioneer Media!
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Positive signal: first project reached day 0 (2026-07-12) and Mia replied politely [email:53670234]. But reply was a brief brush-off, no invite sent in 6 days despite two prompts [email:09ecf9ef, email:bccf78c3], no tickets, Starter solo use, and only 8 days left. Low-but-real odds of unaided milestone.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Pioneer Media's setup
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for the note — glad the first project is up. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the next natural step is getting a bit of real work into that project, and having one teammate alongside you usually makes it click (a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time).

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I can walk through your project with you and point out the quickest next step for Pioneer Media. Happy to work over email instead if that's easier.

Best,
Chidi
